name: fetch-web-vendor
description: Builds hub/web/vendor.js: the third-party code the web page uses. Run: npm ci && npm run build

scripts.build: esbuild entry.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --legal-comments=eof --target=es2017,safari15 --banner:js="/* Fetch vendor bundle, built by tools/vendor (npm run build). Contains @noble/ciphers 1.3.0 and @noble/hashes 1.8.0 (MIT, Paul Miller) and qrcode-generator 1.5.2 (MIT, Kazuhiko Arase). Do not edit by hand. */" --outfile=../../hub/web/vendor.js
